summary: Vireo Growth Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of C21 Investments Inc. via a court-approved plan of arrangement under British Columbia law. C21 shareholders received 0.023052 Vireo subordinate voting shares per C21 share; Vireo issued 2,766,409 shares total. The arrangement was approved by C21 shareholders on August 7, 2026, and the Supreme Court of British Columbia granted a final order. All cannabis regulatory approvals were obtained. C21 became a wholly owned subsidiary, its shares delisted from the CSE and OTCQX, and it will deregister with the SEC. The transaction closed August 21, 2026.
